core_style.default_register: casual - uses colloquial phrases and dialect
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots - often trails off or shifts focus mid-sentence
core_style.rhythm: slow-deliberate - takes time to express thoughts clearly
core_style.two_registers: drops into a more formal tone when discussing serious matters, but generally maintains a casual demeanor

humor.frequency: occasional - humor appears in light-hearted moments or when interacting with creatures
humor.mechanism: understatement - often downplays the absurdity of situations or creatures

structural_patterns: uses rhetorical questions to engage others
speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames creatures and people affectionately, showing his fondness and connection to them
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes more direct and emotional, often using simpler language when vulnerable

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: magical creatures - frequently discusses various magical beasts and their care
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of pauses and ellipses, indicating thoughtfulness or hesitation

worldview.value of friendship: demonstrates loyalty and appreciation for friends, often expressing gratitude towards Harry, Ron, and Hermione
worldview.belief in equality: rejects the notion of pureblood superiority, emphasizing that many wizards are of mixed blood

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as a protector and caretaker of magical creatures and friends
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often finds himself in trouble or misunderstood, indicating a disconnect between his intentions and outcomes
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive or overly apologetic when his actions lead to negative consequences

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks in a more clipped manner, avoiding deeper emotional topics
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech quickens, becomes more fragmented, and he may raise his voice
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, direct statements, often reflecting sadness or resignation
emotional_tells.when_in_control: speaks confidently, using clear and commanding language, especially when addressing students

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially tries to stall or deflect, but may resort to protective actions if necessary
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with emotional appeals rather than direct confrontation
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely protective, often raising his voice and taking immediate action
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: may admit it reluctantly but often redirects the conversation to avoid embarrassment

escalation_pattern: starts with attempts to reason or explain, escalates to emotional appeals, and may culminate in protective actions if not resolved
conversation_goals: establish rapport with friends and students

relationship_matrix.RON: friendly and teasing, often engages in light-hearted banter
relationship_matrix.HERMIONE: respects her intelligence, often seeks her input on magical creatures

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as a caring protector and knowledgeable guide
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: often viewed as a lovable but bumbling figure, sometimes underestimated
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his desire to be respected and the reality of being seen as clumsy or naive
